items.text: The proper human relationship to nature is:

options.A: Mastery and control for human benefit
options.E: Submission to natural processes and limits

items.text: Geoengineering could solve climate change but involves massive intervention in natural systems. We should:

options.A: Embrace it—human ingenuity can solve human problems
options.B: Probably use it as one tool among many
options.C: Use very cautiously given unknown consequences
options.D: Avoid it—we shouldn't further manipulate nature
options.E: Never do it—nature shouldn't be engineered

items.text: The drive to control nature is:

options.A: The source of human achievement and progress
options.B: Mostly positive with some need for restraint
options.C: A mixed blessing—both achievement and destruction
options.E: Our greatest flaw—we must learn to live within limits
